occurrences.quote: Did Craig Heyer play sports at a college located in Clark County, Nevada (other than any community colleges)?

From passage [1], Craig Heyer played college baseball at both the College of Southern Nevada and University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV).

From passage [7], the College of Southern Nevada (CSN) is located in Clark County, Nevada and is a two-year college.

From passage [2], it confirms that Clark County Community College (now known as the College of Southern Nevada) is in Las Vegas.
